name: Longhouse
description: Increases your Villager capacity by +10 and your maximum Population by +25. Produces Bondi spearmen but 25% slower. Can be upgraded with one of four possible attachments to increase the versatility of the Longhouse.
descriptionCN: 将您的村民容量增加 10，最大人口增加 25。生产邦地长矛兵，但速度降低25% 。可通过四种附加组件之一升级，提升长屋的多功能性。
influences: The cost of ships in all Docks are reduced by 4% for each Longhouse within influence of any Dock up to a maximum of 16%.
